fair_indicators.label: Persistent identifier
fair_indicators.explain: A dataset DOI is reported and is registered with DataCite or resolves.

fair_indicators.label: Rich metadata
fair_indicators.explain: A standard documentation framework (datasheet, data card, data statement, Croissant) is used.

fair_indicators.label: Indexed
fair_indicators.explain: The dataset DOI is registered and findable in DataCite.

fair_indicators.label: Retrievable
fair_indicators.explain: At least one dataset link resolves in the 2026 audit.

fair_indicators.label: Open protocol
fair_indicators.explain: Files can be downloaded openly, without forms, approval or login walls.

fair_indicators.label: Persistent hosting
fair_indicators.explain: Hosted on an archival repository (Zenodo, Dataverse, Figshare, OSF, ICPSR, GESIS...).

fair_indicators.label: Open formats
fair_indicators.explain: Released in open, widely readable formats (CSV, JSON(L), Parquet, GraphML...).

fair_indicators.label: Clear license
fair_indicators.explain: A license or explicit terms of use are stated.

fair_indicators.label: Provenance
fair_indicators.explain: Collection method and temporal coverage (start and end) are reported.

fair_indicators.label: Reusable pipeline
fair_indicators.explain: Code to collect, hydrate or load the data is released.
